021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
022import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.display.DisplayManagerPutEvent;
023import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.display.DisplayManagerRemoveEvent;
024import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
025import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.ShopChunk;
026import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
027
028import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
029
030/**
031 * Manages the display functionality for various display type entities.
032 *
033 * @param <T> The type of object or entity used for rendering displays.
034 *
035 * @author creatorfromhell
036 * @since 6.3.0.0
037 */
038public interface DisplayManager<T> {
039
040  /**
041   * Retrieves a mapping between ShopChunk objects and their associated lists of display entities.
042   *
043   * This method provides access to the internal data structure used by the display manager to store and
044   * organize displays according to their respective ShopChunk locations. The returned mapping allows
045   * efficient retrieval, addition, or removal of display entities based on chunk-specific contexts.
046   *
047   * @return A {@code ConcurrentHashMap} where the keys represent {@code ShopChunk} objects,
048   *         and the values are lists of display entities of type {@code T} associated with the respective chunks.
049   */
050  ConcurrentHashMap<ShopChunk, ConcurrentHashMap<Integer, T>> chunksMapping();
051
052  /**
053   * Loads the required resources, configurations, or internal states for this display manager.
054   * This method prepares the manager for operation, ensuring it is in a ready state to handle
055   * display-related actions, such as creating or managing displays.
056   *
057   * Typically invoked during the initialization process or when reloading the manager.
058   */
059  void load();
060
061  /**
062   * Unloads the resources, configurations, or internal states for this display manager.
063   * This method is typically used to clean up or release resources when the display manager
064   * is no longer needed or is being shut down.
065   *
066   * Invoking this method ensures that the manager releases any held resources properly
067   * and avoids potential memory leaks or unintended behavior.
068   */
069  void unload();
070
071  /**
072   * Creates and returns a new display instance associated with the specified shop.
073   *
074   * @param shop The shop for which the display instance will be created. Must not be null.
075   * @return The newly created display instance of type {@code T}.
076   * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the provided shop is invalid or null.
077   */
078  T create(@NotNull final Shop shop);
079
080  /**
081   * Adds a display object to the display manager, associating it with a specified {@code ShopChunk}
082   * and a unique location hash.
083   *
084   * This method creates a new {@code DisplayManagerPutEvent} to handle the insertion operation.
085   * The display is then added to the internal mapping of chunks to displays for efficient management.
086   *
087   * @param key The {@code ShopChunk} representing the specific location for this display.
088   *            Must not be null.
089   * @param locationHash A unique integer hash that identifies the specific location within the chunk.
090   * @param display The display object to associate with the specified {@code ShopChunk}.
091   *                Must not be null.
092   */
093  default void put(@NotNull final ShopChunk key, final int locationHash, @NotNull final T display) {
094
095    final DisplayManagerPutEvent<T> event = new DisplayManagerPutEvent<>(key, display);
096    event.callEvent();
097
098    chunksMapping().computeIfAbsent(key, k -> new ConcurrentHashMap<>()).put(locationHash, display);
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Removes the specified display object associated with the given ShopChunk key
103   * from the manager. This operation detaches the display from the provided
104   * ShopChunk context.
105   *
106   * @param key The ShopChunk key representing the specific chunk related to the shop.
107   *            Must not be null.
108   * @param locationHash A unique integer hash that identifies the specific location within the chunk.
109   * @param display The display object to be removed from the manager. This represents
110   *                the display entity or type being managed. Must not be null.
111   */
112  default void remove(@NotNull final ShopChunk key, final int locationHash, @NotNull final T display) {
113
114    final DisplayManagerRemoveEvent<T> event = new DisplayManagerRemoveEvent<>(key, display);
115    event.callEvent();
116
117    chunksMapping().computeIfPresent(key, (mapKey, displays) -> {
118
119      displays.remove(locationHash);
120
121      return displays.isEmpty() ? null : displays;
122    });
123  }
124
125  default boolean allowEnchants() {
126    return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getConfig().getBoolean("shop.display-allow-enchants", true);
127  }
128
129  default boolean useItemName() {
130    return QuickShopAPI.getInstance().getConfig().getBoolean("shop.display-item-use-name");
131  }
132}
